PRELIMINARY KARYOTYPE REPORT

Patient: [redacted name]
MRN: [redacted ID]
DOB: [redacted date]
Specimen Type: Peripheral blood
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

REFERRING PHYSICIAN: Dr. [redacted name]
Department: Pediatrics

TEST PERFORMED
Conventional Cytogenetic Analysis (Karyotype)
Methodology: Cultured peripheral blood lymphocytes, GTG-banding at 550 band resolution

PRELIMINARY RESULT
Karyotype: ABNORMAL - Structural chromosome abnormality detected

A structural chromosome rearrangement has been identified during routine karyotype analysis. The exact nature and breakpoints of this abnormality require further characterization.

15 metaphases analyzed
Banding resolution: 550 bands

FOLLOW-UP TESTING IN PROGRESS
Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) studies have been initiated to:
- Confirm the chromosome abnormality
- Precisely characterize breakpoints
- Determine if material has been gained or lost

The FISH analysis is currently in progress using targeted probes based on the suspected rearrangement identified by conventional cytogenetics.

RECOMMENDATIONS
1. FISH report to follow with detailed characterization of the identified abnormality
2. Clinical correlation recommended once full cytogenetic characterization is complete
3. Parental karyotype studies may be indicated pending final results

This is a preliminary report. A comprehensive report including FISH findings will be issued upon completion of supplementary studies.

Reported by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director: [redacted name], MD, PhD

For questions regarding this report, please contact the Cytogenetics Laboratory at [redacted phone]
